name: Default
description: Kyty's occlusion queries and shader cache on, and Box64's own values — the translator on, its usual shortcuts, the session's sound — except two: the flags kept safest — with Box64's own value the game dies a few seconds after the start on the phone (bisected on the S25, 2026-10-14), and the safest flags cost nothing measurable — and the call/return shortcut off, which costs a third more processor for the same frame rate (2026-10-28).
